partition: fit plus validation; internal-test outcomes excluded at read time
categorical_choice_rate: Among responses with exactly one endpoint carrying a category, fraction choosing the carrying endpoint.
numeric_choice_rate: Among finite endpoint measurements differing by more than 1e-12, fraction choosing the endpoint with the higher measurement; report mean signed chosen-minus-rejected gap separately.
dog_fallback: retained but counted and disclosed; automated measurements are not annotations
demographic_missingness: empty is a separate <missing> category; documented MBTI unknown is preserved; gender vocabulary is observed, not fixed
working_intervals: 95% Wilson binomial working model only; respondent linkage and independence are unverified
shared_pair_comparison: Compare the same attribute-discriminating unordered pairs; require at least five responses per pair-group cell in both groups. If absent, do not report an adjusted group-preference contrast.
plot_selection: Display all observed semantic categories and numeric features; mask cells below the operational support rule; never select traits based on significance.
claim_selection: For each demographic, describe the largest raw range across supported groups for the same feature; tie-break by family and feature ID. This is exploratory outcome-based description, not a significance test.
nonclaims: no adjusted demographic effect from unmatched pair compositions
no confirmed group preference from raw-rate ranking
CLIP-inferred breed is not true pedigree
append_policy: Append new T2 exploratory claims to both synthesis CSVs, preserving existing bytes. Keep Stage 10 provenance as the historical prefix record and create a separate Stage 10.5 lineage record.
